name: Sweet ~Hanjuku na Tenshi-tachi~
source:
Main character just graduated from medical university. He finds work at "Saint Angels Hospital"  managed by his uncle. He grows up as physician and deepens his relations with various girls - nurses, students, female doctors. patients...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角刚从医科大学毕业，进入叔父经营的“圣天使医院”工作。他一边成长为医生，一边加深与护士、学生、女医生和病人等形形色色女性的关系……

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
